title: SnitchClone - Fashion E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-stack fashion e-commerce platform inspired by Snitch, built with the MERN stack with secure authentication, role-based access control, product management, variants, and shopping cart functionality.

title: PerplexityClone - AI Search & Chat
description: A full-stack AI-powered search and chat application inspired by Perplexity AI, integrating Google Gemini, Mistral AI, and Tavily Search for real-time web-backed responses.

title: Estate - Real Estate Web Application
description: A modern and responsive real estate web application built with React, featuring property listings, property details, search and filtering, responsive UI, and a Web3Forms-powered contact form.

title: FitX - Fitness Web Application
description: A modern and responsive fitness web application built with React and Tailwind CSS, featuring interactive user profiles, responsive design, and a custom typing animation hook.

title: UberClone - Ride Booking Platform
description: A full-stack ride-booking application inspired by Uber with user and captain authentication, profile management, JWT-based security, protected routes, and an organized MVC backend architecture.
